title: EG&G interview switched mid-way to the S-4 job

tellings.quote: interviewed me for that and somewhere in the middle of it they said, "You know, we actually have a different job that we're thinking of plugging you into now."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on secret craft at a hidden Nevada site called S-4, says that in 1988 he went to Las Vegas for a job interview at EG&G, a defense contractor, and partway through, the interviewers changed course. In his own telling to Michels they said: "You know, we actually have a different job that we're thinking of plugging you into now." That other job, he says, was the one that took him to S-4.
